title: CUHK Vice-Chancellor's PhD Scholarship Scheme
institution: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)
about: CUHK's Vice-Chancellor's PhD Scholarship Scheme supports full-time PhD entrants for 2027-28. Applicants are considered automatically when they apply to a full-time PhD by the main-round deadline of 1 December 2026 (11:59 pm HKT).
requirements: Candidates applying for the full-time PhD programme through the Online Application System by the deadline are considered automatically; no separate application
Main round 1 December 2026; clearing round 31 March 2027 only if places remain
HKPFS applicants submit the RGC initial application by 12 noon, 1 December 2026 (HKT), plus the CUHK application the same day

upskill.name: the full course catalog
why: No course objective covers the stated requirements, which are procedural ("Candidates applying for the full-time PhD programme through the Online Application System by the deadline are considered automatically"); the post links to the Academy catalog instead of a specific course.
